== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Naraka]] [[Travelers]] are individuals who draw power from the [[Territory]] of [[Naraka]], also known as the Cavern of Flame. This realm is associated with law, order, and the pursuit of justice; consequently, these [[Travelers]] are often compelled to uphold high moral principles and punish wrongdoers. Their abilities frequently involve fire or heat-based magic, such as summoning burning insects or manipulating flames. To prepare for their roles, initiates undergo a [[ritual]] involving the consumption of fruit from an [[obsidian tree]], which provides varying degrees of protection against extreme heat. A defining physical characteristic of these individuals is a glowing red rune or brand located on their palms, which they use to perform intricate patterns to summon forces from their [[Territory]] or to hold open [[Naraka]] [[Gates]]. Using these powers, particularly when summoning entities or maintaining gates, often causes them physical pain. [[Naraka]] [[Travelers]] are typically identified by their red robes and may be seen working in teams to manage gates or acting as guards. While they are often driven by a sense of duty, the specific nature of their connection to [[Naraka]] can vary among individuals.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Naraka]] [[Travelers]] are a judgmental group of individuals, such as [[Alin]], who possess empty blue eyes and specific tattoos on their hands. As the granddaughters of [[Grandmaster Naraka]], these travelers guard his door and utilize a dedicated roped-off section for their entry and exit. They demonstrate unique abilities, including the capacity to summon burning insects from thin air, evaporate serpents with a red-marked hand, and transport others to [[Myria]]. Despite being accustomed to mere pain, they maintain the ability to remain cool and dry even in intense heat, though several members were murdered by [[Simon]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Naraka]] [[Travelers]] serve as guards stationed at the tent and are distinguished by their red robes. These individuals perform the essential duty of holding the [[Naraka Gate]] open. While it is noted that [[Cynara]] possessed the qualities to be a wonderful member of this group, [[Leah]] eventually exercises Authority{{!}}authority by ordering the [[Travelers]] to open a Gate.}}
